title: Sub2API plugin registry version
description: plugins/<key>/versions/<version>.json, written by `sub2api-plugin registry add-version`. Once merged only `deprecated` may be added.

version.description: Semantic version; equals the file name and manifest.version.

url.description: Release asset of the plugin's repo: https://github.com/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<file>.s2plugin

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the .s2plugin file.

size.description: Size of the .s2plugin file in bytes (at most PluginPackageMaxBytes, 64 MiB).

host_compat.description: manifest.hostCompat, a semver constraint on the core version.
